findings.title: `.topic-meta-data h5 a` light-theme lightness is inverted from 30% to 70%, so the link becomes pale gray on white
findings.description: The removed line was `color: scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%);`. The new line is `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%))`. `dark-light-choose` returns its first argument when `brightness($primary) < brightness($secondary)` (the light theme, per `common/foundation/variables.scss:46-51`). So in the light theme this link now renders at 70% lightness, which is near-background on a white header. The dark-theme arm is the mirror of that wrong value. The correct pair is `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))`.

findings.title: `.custom-message-length` light-theme lightness is inverted from 70% to 30%, so the hint text turns dark gray
findings.description: The removed line was `color: scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%);`. The new line is `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))`. The light arm is now 30%, so in the light theme the hint text renders as dark gray where it used to be light gray. The arms are swapped. The correct pair is `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%))`. The desktop equivalent in `desktop/modal.scss:94` has the correct pair, which supports this.

findings.title: `.group-member-info .name` light-theme lightness changed from 30% to 50%, and the dark arm is 50% instead of its mirror
findings.description: The removed line was `color: scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%);`. The new line is `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))`. In the light theme the member name is now lighter than before. The dark arm should be `scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%)` to mirror 30%, not 50%. The correct line is `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))`.

findings.title: `.group-member-info .name` light-theme lightness changed from 30% to 50% in the mobile stylesheet
findings.description: This is the same defect as the desktop `.name` rule. The removed line was `color: scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%);`, and the new line is `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))`. The correct line is `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))`.

findings.title: Mobile `h3` light-theme lightness changed from 20% to 50%, and the dark arm is 50% instead of 80%
findings.description: The removed line was `color: scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%);`. The new line is `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))`. The light-theme heading is now mid-gray instead of near-black, and the dark-theme heading is mid-gray instead of near-white. The desktop `h3` rule in `desktop/topic-post.scss:321` uses the correct `(20%, 80%)` pair, which confirms the fix: `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 80%))`.
